name: Deva

source.note: Shape-shifting is its at-will Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid only, no Concentration).

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.summary: If it dies away from its home plane, its body vanishes and it re-forms there with all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Holy Mace
actions.summary: A mace blow carrying a burst of radiant power.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Charisma, DC 17: Detect Evil and Good and Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid) at will; Commune and Raise Dead once a day.
actions.text: It casts with Charisma (save DC 17), needing no Material components. At will: Detect Evil and Good, and Shapechange limited to Beast or Humanoid forms, without Concentration and without the spell's Temporary Hit Points. 1/day each: Commune, Raise Dead.

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid
bonus_actions.summary: Twice a day: casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration or Remove Curse.
bonus_actions.text: Uses the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action. The two uses cover all three spells.

summary: A radiant warrior angel: two holy mace blows, healing magic for allies, and resistance to magic.
